task: W78 private PSD parser-cache race repair candidate; W81 route-side raster source binding supplement

baselineReproduction.result: REPRODUCED with actual psd-tools PSD and Flask handler: initial request returns 409 after A->B replacement; restoring A at same path and mtime returns HTTP 200 with digest A but B's visible composite pixel [15,180,90] instead of A [200,10,20].

changes: The private server wires an invalidator for its actual path-keyed _psd_cache. A digest-aware PSD import that detects changed bytes evicts any parsed object acquired during the raced operation; downstream tree/build failures after parser acquisition also evict conservatively.
Response-cache hits re-fingerprint immediately before returning cached success; changed bytes return 409 and the stale response entry is discarded.
The parser loader's legacy no-digest behavior is unchanged.

keyResults: Real PSD fixed-mtime A->raced B->restore A returns the correct A pixel and digest after invalidation.
Cache-hit race returns 409 without a digest; stable B retry has matching digest/composite.
A raced parser followed by controlled layer-tree failure evicts its object; restored A retry returns A.
Direct no-digest parser-cache callers retain mtime-only object reuse.
No raw source bytes returned; provider/native calls 0.
Optional sourceBytesSha256 binds /api/psd-rasterize-all to the import's bytes, uses digest-aware parser cache, checks again after rasterization, and returns a matching digest receipt.
Wrong or malformed expected digest is rejected; replacement before parse or after raster generation returns 409 and evicts parser state.
Legacy callers without the digest field still receive successful old-shape responses.

verification.syntax: python -m py_compile passed for candidate server, route and W78/W81 tests.

integrationRequirement.mustDo: The actual client must pass the digest returned by /api/psd-import into /api/psd-rasterize-all and validate the raster response receipt before committing the layered document.
integrationRequirement.currentReviewLimit: This report verifies only private candidate routes; it does not claim the loaded client has been updated. Without digest-bearing second request, the import-tree/composite and raster responses can still observe different file versions.

limits: No live server files were written, no server was restarted, and no native app/provider/browser calls occurred.

The private route registration keeps invalidate_cached_psd optional for compatibility. A separate embedder using the digest-aware import route must supply a matching invalidation callback to close the parser-cache poison path; the candidate server registration does so.
Cache-hit safety uses a second streaming fingerprint. A file can still be replaced after that final check; this is a filesystem race boundary, not an atomic file-handle snapshot guarantee.
The W81 endpoint is now byte-bindable, but end-to-end safety depends on the parent integrating the client request/receipt check before document commit.
